desc.en: Increases Attribute DMG by 12%. When using Intro Skill or Resonance Skill, gain a stacking Resonance Skill DMG boost of up to 48%. Jinhsi's absolute best-in-class option.
Increases ATK by 3% every 2s upon entering the field, stacking up to 5 times. High base attack and high ATK scaling make it a solid free-to-play weapon.

Increases Crit Rate and boosts Resonance Attribute DMG by 12%. When casting Resonance Skill or when dealing damage off-field, ATK increases by 12% for 2 stacks. The absolute best choice for her dual on-field/off-field role.
When Resonance Skill is cast, increases ATK by 12% for 15s. Generates extra energy to help maintain critical ultimate uptime. Very accessible F2P option.
Grants high Crit Rate and increases Energy Regen by 12%. Upon switching out, the incoming Resonator gains 10% ATK for 14 seconds. Provides great raw DPS stats and team utility.
Increases Resonance Skill DMG by 20% for 15s upon casting Intro Skill. Highly synergistic with Chixia's reliance on her rapid-fire skill hits.

Provides massive Crit DMG. Increases ATK by 12%. When dealing damage, grants stacks that increase Resonance Skill DMG by up to 56%. Specially designed to unleash Changli's skill-intensive combat rotation.
When Intro Skill is triggered, increases ATK by 15% for 15s. Excellent F2P weapon with a straightforward trigger condition for quickswap builds.
Shorekeeper's signature weapon. Provides massive HP% scaling and substantial Energy Regen. When casting Resonance Liberation, triggers team-wide ATK% and Crit Rate enhancements.
Grants exceptionally high Energy Regen. Restores 8 Concerto Energy upon casting Resonance Skill, vastly speeding up team rotation speeds. Excellent F2P utility.
A sturdy broadblade forged for night patrol. Increases basic attack damage slightly.
A basic sword commonly distributed to new recruits in Jinzhou.
Simple training pistols with dummy ammunition. Used for target practice.
Increases ATK by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). Every time Basic Attack or Intro Skill is cast, Heavy Attack DMG Bonus increases by (48%/60%/72%/84%/96%) for 3s.
Increases Heavy Attack DMG by 12% and when casting Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation, boosts Heavy Attack DMG by 38%.
Increases ATK by 4% on dealing Basic or Heavy Attack DMG, stacking up to 5 times.
Increases Energy Regen by 12.8%. When Resonance Skill is cast, ATK is increased by 6%, stacking up to 2 times.
